out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food (bag of onions) stored on the floor in dry storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CDI: CFM relocated bag of onions to shelf in the kitchen.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry (watch) on their arms and hands while preparing food in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. CDI: Employee removed watch before washing hands/ replaced gloves and returned to food prep.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shelled eggs stored above packages of shredded cheddar and mozzarella cheese inside Ikon 3 Dr UR refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: CFM relocated packages of shredded cheddar and mozzarella to top shelf inside 3 Dr prep refrigerator.
